evidence.detail: R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registers rs/l/f/a/c/b directly as exact ScriptPacket ID 7.
The handler exclusively owns rs/l/f/a/c/a, whose constructor preserves the exact identity literal 'BossBarOverlay' and default percentage text '100%'.

After lazily constructing and attaching the overlay, every implemented selector mutates only that BossBarOverlay instance. Selector 1 resets/toggles it, selector 2 updates two integer state values, selectors 4 and 7 update current/max progress and derived percentage state, selector 5 updates a String field, and selector 6 updates an icon-prefixed numeric String. Selector 3 has no branch.

Selectors 4 and 7 read current and maximum integers, derive a clamped 0/100-or-ratio percentage, and store the resulting progress plus formatted current/max/percentage strings directly on BossBarOverlay.
The packet also writes BossBarOverlay display Strings directly, including the surviving '<img=381>...' format used by selector 6, without touching any unrelated Client subsystem.

candidates.note: BossBarOverlayPacketHandler is fixed by exact ScriptPacket ID 7, the surviving BossBarOverlay identity literal, and an exclusive whole-class write surface into that overlay. Confidence is 0.999.
